environment.render: Xorg dummy :96, TCP disabled; OpenGL 4.5 Compatibility/Mesa llvmpipe
environment.audio: Actual AudioServer software output through Dummy backend; no physical output device

production.review: First crowded sheets rejected; reference edits isolated poses. Actual PNG bytes unchanged; native alpha reader derives regions/foot pivots/scale. IDs/hashes in media/provenance.json and motion-catalog.json.

before: Single static pose with bob/flash per character and immediate radial blade damage.
after: Real walk/blade/dodge/cast and Warden anticipation/active/recovery poses. Locked-aim 100ms blade and 75ms seal contact, one committed action, slower movement, visible recovery and dodge/hurt cancellation. Pose/cue/damage share actual contact; pause/result/restart own their clocks.
comparison_limit: Same unchanged scripted reactive controller and fixed timestep, not independent human balance/difficulty evidence. Position/state boundary fixtures are declared, not undisclosed player behavior.

rendered_review.scope: Native contact/preparation, charge/wave/sweep poses, isolated cells, both facing orientations/wall bounds and expanded tactics. Body pose changes while telegraphs/explicit status remain legible at native size. Some generated proportions vary; no independent artist approval.
rendered_review.source: Delivered PCK run from /workspace/work/veil-motion, outside project sources
rendered_review.movie: Godot Movie Maker, 216 actual frames at 30 FPS, then ffmpeg H.264/AAC faststart encoding and complete decode check

limitations: Four-keyframe clips and horizontal mirrors, not hand animation or eight-direction coverage.
PCK requires matching Godot runtime; no standalone OS export.
Movie Maker uses fixed timestep and declared fixtures/scripted input, not human play or hardware frame-rate measurement.
Physical input/listening, human motion/strategy/enjoyment feedback, other platforms/accessibility, exclusive rights and commercial demand unverified.
